name: MSE + LPIPS + spectral magnitude/phase
tagline: MSE on velocity plus LPIPS, FFT magnitude L1, and amplitude-weighted phase consistency on the denoised image, with quadratic time decay and warm-up ramp.
init_recovers: Pure velocity MSE before ramp activates
diff_from_baseline: Replaces lpips_spectral's gradient/multiscale auxiliaries with an amplitude-weighted phase term (1-cos(Δφ)) and adds a 1000-step ramp.

name: Multi-band spectral + phase perceptual
tagline: MSE plus LPIPS, gradient and multiscale L1, banded FFT magnitude with low/mid/high weights, and a unit-vector phase loss on the denoised image.

key_hyperparams.name: frequency bands
key_hyperparams.role: (low, high, weight) per radial band on |FFT|

key_hyperparams.name: λ_grad / λ_multi
key_hyperparams.role: Sobel gradient and multiscale L1 weights

init_recovers: lpips_spectral baseline if bands collapse and phase weight → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds a radial-band weighted FFT magnitude (low/mid/high) and a unit-vector real/imag phase L1 to the lpips_spectral stack, with mid-band weighting (0.6).

name: LPIPS + focal log-magnitude spectral
tagline: MSE plus LPIPS and a tri-component spectral term combining standard, focal-weighted, and log-magnitude FFT differences, time-weighted by (1-t)^2.
init_recovers: lpips_spectral baseline if focal+log terms vanish
diff_from_baseline: Drops gradient and multiscale terms; adds a focal magnitude (|Δ|² normalized by max|Δ|) and log-magnitude term to the LPIPS+spectral stack.

name: Target-anchored perceptual + phase
tagline: MSE+Charbonnier on velocity plus LPIPS/grad/multiscale/spectral losses anchored against both the clean image and the target-induced denoised image, with amplitude-gated phase alignment.

key_hyperparams.name: anchor mix
key_hyperparams.role: blend of clean-image and target-denoised perceptual losses

key_hyperparams.name: λ_spec / λ_phase
key_hyperparams.role: spectral magnitude and amplitude-gated phase weights

init_recovers: lpips_grad if anchor mix → clean-only and spectral/phase → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds (i) target-induced denoised image $x-t v_{\mathrm{target}}$ as an extra anchor for LPIPS/grad/multi, (ii) amplitude-gated Fourier phase alignment $|A_t|\,|\Delta\hat\phi|$, and (iii) a small Charbonnier velocity term.

name: Log-spectral + phase perceptual stack
tagline: MSE plus LPIPS, log-magnitude spectral, magnitude-weighted phase coherence, gradient and multiscale L1, ramped over the first 1000 steps.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces raw FFT magnitude L1 (lpips_spectral) with a log(1+|F|) magnitude loss and adds magnitude-weighted phase coherence (1-cos Δφ); decays grad/multi weights to 0.02 and warms in over 1000 steps.
